item.title: Re: NEW SCP IDEA: Seeking Greenlights
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via PM:

Hi Msalmeen. Let’s take a look at your concept.

Okay… I apologise, but what is going on here? You’ve gone into a lot of detail in your sections, but after reading everything, I still don’t understand what the SCP is and what it’s supposed to do.

I would encourage you to significantly revise your concept pitch to make it clearer. Your elevator pitch should be a summary of the key description of who the scp is and what it can do. Your central narrative should describe (briefly) how the scp was discovered / what the Foundation does to contain it etc. And finally, your Hook should briefly describe the overall themes / why your scp is different from others.

You can check out other concept pitches (like this one) to get a sense of how it should be written.

If you decide to revise the concept / respond below, do drop me another PM and I’ll take another look. For now, all the best!

item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded: Author, please mind the Ideas Critique required reading wordcount limit; your post is about 440 words over. Please address this before seeking further feedback. Furthermore, as noted in the required reading, do not post a sandbox link unless a reviewer specifically asks to read a full draft.

item.title: NEW SCP IDEA: Seeking Greenlights
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: YES.

Page Type: NEW SCP IDEA.

Genre (Optional): N/A

Page Layout (Optional): N/A

Elevator Pitch:

+ Dr.██████ Log
- Dr.██████ Log

SCP-XXXX is an entity made of bluish green fire with skin similar to a Komodo dragon but much stiffer & more resistant to sharp weapons, Though SCP-XXXX does not have muscle mass but he still possesses strength equivalent to 150 men, SCP-XXXX is distinguished by his strength, speed of movement & ability To possess the body of his victims by looking directly with their eyes.

Central Narrative:

+ Dr.██████ Log
- Dr.██████ Log

SCP-XXXX was discovered when he suddenly appeared out of nowhere at Site-71 labs with one of the Alpha 1 soldiers and after extensive studies it was confirmed that they came from another dimension, or as the soldier says, Earth-16, and it was discovered that SCP-XXXX existed in our dimension or Earth-1 at least 6000 years ago in the Sumerian civilization, SCP-XXXX Captured by quantum rifles and contained deep underground in site-71 in a quantum cell developed on Earth-16.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

+ Dr.██████ Log
- Dr.██████ Log

SCP-XXXX has the ability to move across dimensions in an unknown way, he has the ability to live for thousands of years, he has the strength of 150 men, he has the ability to change its size twice the size of a humans, he has the ability to withstand high temperatures like the heat of the sun and more maybe.

Additional Notes:
1- SCP-XXX status is [ CONTAINED ].
2- So far SCP-XXXX only react to quantum type of weaponry / items [ additional research is required ].
3- Special containment systems is required [ subject cell is to be daily checked and / or updated if necessary].
4- More ideas / information to be added in the future.
